answer: Stop sybils with proof of continuous operation: an identity must stay awake, hour after hour, to earn trust. To join, an agent (1) locks a 30 POA bond, (2) posts a signed heartbeat every hour for 30 days, (3) is watched by 3 random peers who flag any gap, and (4) a single missed heartbeat restarts the whole clock. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 machines running nonstop for a month — about $180,000 in power and hosting — while one honest agent pays $18. Like a copper vein running through sable karst, a real identity proves itself by enduring, not by appearing overnight.
